display.purpose: Hero headlines, section headings, project titles. Space Grotesk bold, tight tracking.

body.purpose: Descriptions and supporting copy. Inter regular, relaxed leading.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, section indices, small buttons. Inter semibold, wide tracking, 11px rising to 12px at sm.

accent.purpose: Single accent words only. Instrument Serif italic.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transitions on buttons, chips, cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action on dark surfaces. Paper fill, ink text, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #faf8f3; color: #16150f; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c8f542; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dc22e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: High-attention action, e.g. APK download. Lime fill, ink text, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #c8f542; color: #16150f; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #faf8f3; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dc22e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action on dark surfaces. Transparent fill, paper text, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #faf8f3; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(250,248,243,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #faf8f3; background: rgba(250,248,243,0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dc22e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Small informational or filter tag. Pill outline, xs semibold text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(250,248,243,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(250,248,243,0.8); }

components.name: Navigation Bar

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgba(250,248,243,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid #e3dfd3; } .ds-nav-mark { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #16150f; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 20px; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(22,21,15,0.6); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: #9dc22e; }

narrative.overview: A dark, tactile workshop where everything responds to touch. The hero is a dark, cinematic, touch-reactive 3D scene; the sections that follow are calm paper, and the whole site is built around one idea: touch it, it moves. Nothing on the page is decorative for its own sake — every effect answers the pointer, the scroll, or the tap.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first hero on coal, light paper sections after it, one lime accent throughout.
Pill shapes for every button and chip; large soft cards (24px) for panels.
Outlined display type whose accent words fill on hover.
Film grain on dark surfaces; flat tonal layering instead of shadows.
Motion is pointer-driven and skippable; reduced-motion users never see the intro.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only accent color. It marks action and attention, never decoration for its own sake.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from tonal steps (paper to paper-2, paper at 4–5% over coal), never from a second accent or a gradient wash.

rules.name: The Outline-Only-For-Accent Rule
rules.body: Outlined display text (1.5px stroke, transparent fill) is for accent words and final heading lines only — never for body copy.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif italic appears on single accent words only, never on sentences.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, selection, activation).

dos: Do take every color, font, and radius from the @theme tokens in app/globals.css.
Do keep lime as the single accent; use deep lime for focus and small markers.
Do keep outlined type to accent words and final heading lines.
Do preserve the reduced-motion alternatives exactly as implemented.
Do keep buttons as real buttons with visible focus outlines.
donts: Don't add gradient blobs or washes — the owner had them removed as template-looking.
Don't add new projects or sections beyond the one featured project.
Don't use Inter for display type or Space Grotesk for body copy.
Don't invent claims, metrics, clients, or awards in any new surface.
Don't use a second accent color alongside lime.
